title: Persistent project assistants
description: Version 1 additive contract. No router or server is installed by this schema. All timestamps are RFC3339 UTC strings. Arrays are always arrays, never null.
$comment: Source machine authority and feature opt-in are mandatory.

ProjectAssistantShape.description: Codync outline vocabulary. Global entry is always blob/#e39567; it never identifies the selected Bot.

ProjectAssistantPermissionPolicy.description: Applies only inside the enforced read-only native sandbox. No native answer can authorize repository writes.

ProjectAssistantEffectState.description: Acceptance is durable admission; delivery is a persisted reply; observation and read require separate device acknowledgements. Unknown is never automatically executed again.

ProjectAssistantEventKind.description: Each event has exactly the corresponding typed payload. trace_updated uses Trace; event sequences never count as unread messages.

ProjectAssistantProjectSelection.description: Only registered IDs, never an arbitrary cwd. Resolve on the source machine at creation and before execution.

ProjectAssistantProjectScope.description: Linked worktrees resolve to the existing canonical repository. Non-repository places retain their own identity.

ProjectAssistantInstructions.description: Captured at the next idle turn; running turn snapshots are immutable.

ProjectAssistantCapabilities.description: Unknown version/capability is unavailable. Provider probes must supply actual evidence before native mode is enabled.

mode.description: The agent mode the Bot works in: auto (or empty) for the agent's Auto mode, otherwise one the agent offers (API level 65).

ProjectAssistantCreateSettings.description: Six settings. Creating, cancelling, reading, selecting and searching start no process or model. Only first send binds execution.

mode.description: The agent mode the Bot works in: auto (or empty) for the agent's Auto mode, otherwise one the agent offers (API level 65).

ProjectAssistantEditSettings.description: Complete editable settings replacement. Agent/model/Project/policy changes, archive and deletion are outside v1.

mode.description: The agent mode the Bot works in: auto (or empty) for the agent's Auto mode, otherwise one the agent offers (API level 65).

permission_policy.description: Empty leaves the permission setting unchanged (API level 65).

ProjectAssistantFence.description: Must match current source authority on every RPC, permission answer, native event and tool call. Before first execution binding_id is empty and generation is zero; only send admission may replace that initial fence.

started_at.description: When the turn began running, RFC 3339; absent while it waits.

joined_turn_id.description: The running turn this queued message was sent into with Send now; absent otherwise.

ProjectAssistantExecutionBinding.description: Internal binding identity is safe to expose; native_session_id must be redacted from public roster projections.

ProjectAssistantMemoryRevision.description: Durable tombstones and revision fence future context. Does not claim to erase model training, independent external files or other copies.

ProjectAssistantContextSnapshot.description: A forgotten source in any provenance rejects the whole summary; never silently strip its ID while retaining the text.

ProjectAssistantSourceStatus.description: Offline cached rows stay visibly stale; revoked and unpaired rows cannot be read. An offline source is never an authoritative empty list.

ProjectAssistantReadCursor.description: reader_id is the authenticated Cloud principal, shared across its devices. Source machine stores max(previous,incoming) bounded by last visible message sequence.

ProjectAssistantCommand.description: SHA-256 of canonical validated content, recomputed by source. Scope is machine/Bot/operation/key, not device. At create, client chooses a stable opaque bot_id; same command returns same Bot.

ProjectAssistantListRequest.description: Captured source-local machine_id is required. The UI obtains one client per authorized source and federates their pages; the selected global active machine is never substituted. Cursor is opaque and bound to filter/authorization revision. Page size 1..100.

ProjectAssistantHistoryRequest.description: before_seq=0 starts from latest. Items are ascending within a page. Page size 1..100.

images.description: Pictures as base64 data: URLs, at most four; each is normalized and stored before the message is accepted. A daemon below API level 62 refuses this field.

ProjectAssistantStopRequest.description: Cancels active and queued turns; a collapsed UI never sends this. Naming a turn that is still queued removes only that message (API level 63).

ProjectAssistantTrace.description: Trace is not a visible message and never advances unread. Secrets and raw provider credentials are redacted by source.

ProjectAssistantEvent.description: Exactly one payload matching kind, except feature_disabled which has none. Replay is deduplicated by source machine plus seq/id.

ProjectAssistantEventsRequest.description: Durable source-local cursor, page size 1..256; expired cursor is pa_cursor_expired and requires snapshot refresh.

ProjectAssistantExport.description: Authenticated export only, never roster cache. SQLite remains authoritative. Restore refuses unsupported versions and retains receipt/tombstone identities.

ProjectAssistantAccess.description: Default is hidden. Disabled with preserved data is history_only, allowing authenticated reads/export but no create/send/permission answer.

ProjectAssistantObserveRequest.description: Authenticated device observation of a receipt/event. It does not advance read cursors or turn model text into human authorization.

ProjectAssistantPermissionOptionKind.description: Native option kind is preserved. Persistent choices are never accepted in v1 and cannot widen authority.

ProjectAssistantProjectOption.description: A source-registered choice for Bot configuration. The label is metadata, not proof that a directory or native provider is currently usable. Creation and execution resolve the selected ID again.

icon.description: The Project's mark as the new-Session sheet draws it; absent when the source has none.

ProjectAssistantProjectsRequest.description: Read the source-owned Bot Project catalog. Page size uses the existing 1..100 row bound. The opaque cursor binds the source, principal, grant and complete catalog revision; this does not read the retired /v1/projects catalog.

ProjectAssistantProjectsResponse.description: A complete-row page from one fresh registered-choice revision. Agent values identify configuration kinds accepted by Create and do not assert CLI installation, authentication or native readiness. A byte-limited page advances only through complete returned choices.

ProjectAssistantReadViewMode.description: One optional source-owned read projection; never native authority.

ProjectAssistantReadItemKind.description: Exactly one item payload must match this kind.

ProjectAssistantReadViewRequest.description: Additive read operation. Query modes enforce their own unused-field/epoch rules. Trusted authority binding and byte budget are not wire inputs.

source_epoch.description: Empty only for a new snapshot; otherwise the read-adapter incarnation from that source.

cursor.description: Signed collection position or detail reference, at most4096 UTF-8 bytes; never authorization.

page_size.description: Events up to256; other pages up to100; detail exactly1.

ProjectAssistantReadViewHead.description: One SQL snapshot. Only a successful snapshot-mode response may replace the replay cursor; other page heads never advance it.

event_frontier.description: Machine log high-water mark from the same transaction, not a message sequence.

unknown_turn_count.description: Exact blocking count across execution generations; no old execution authority.

pending_permission_count.description: Stored pending offers under the current complete execution fence, including expired display state.

trace_category_count.description: Latest current-fence trace groups; full text is fetched by reference.

failure_code.description: Empty when absent; no captured instructions or failure narrative.

started_at.description: When the turn began running, RFC 3339; empty while it waits.

ProjectAssistantReadSnapshot.description: Complete mandatory snapshot. Counted pending turns and queued user messages obey the existing16-turn bound; unknown barriers are counted in head. Permissions/traces are separate bounded collections.

detail_cursor.description: Read reference for the complete stored offer. Summary alone never enables an answer.

title.description: The proposed action's one-line description; empty from a daemon without it.

tool_kind.description: The proposed action's ACP tool kind; empty from a daemon without it.

id.description: Stable identity of the exact turn/category tuple.

detail_cursor.description: Read reference for the complete current-fence trace.

ProjectAssistantReadViewItem.description: Exactly one payload matching kind. Internal per-prefix cursor/failure data are omitted.

anchor_message_seq.description: Immutable admission message anchor for timeline rows; zero for other collections.

observed_event_seq.description: Observation frontier, or the event sequence. An older page cannot downgrade a newer work fact.

ProjectAssistantReadViewResponse.description: Snapshot mode alone includes snapshot; collections are always non-null arrays. Every item is complete and full HTTP/Cloud serialization fits the existing8MiB ceiling.

source_epoch.description: Read-adapter incarnation, not a credential or native binding.

next_seq.description: Events last included seq; zero in other modes. Never advance to head.event_frontier on a partial events page.

ProjectAssistantPermissionDiff.description: One file change the native tool proposes, as the adapter reported it.

ProjectAssistantPermissionAction.description: What the native tool asks to do, for the person to read before answering. Display only: it never authorizes anything.

title.description: The adapter's one-line description of the call.

tool_kind.description: ACP tool kind: read, edit, delete, move, search, execute, think, fetch, switch_mode or other.

detail.description: The command, URL or other input, shortened to the registered bound.

shortened.description: True when detail or diffs were shortened to the bound.

ProjectAssistantAttachment.description: A picture sent with a message, named by the SHA-256 of its stored bytes.

ProjectAssistantSendNowRequest.description: Sends one queued message into the running turn, as Codync's steer (API level 64).

ProjectAssistantPermissionRule.description: One standing rule the agent keeps for the Bot's Project after Always allow or Never, as the agent spells it (API level 66).

ProjectAssistantRulesResponse.description: The Bot's Project standing rules; only Claude Code Bots have them (API level 66).

ProjectAssistantRuleRemoveRequest.description: Revokes one standing rule for the Bot's Project (API level 66).
